description: Return every ready-made template on AI Canvas. A template is a complete example screen built from one design system (a dashboard, a console, a control room), installable in one CLI command. Use to discover what full screens exist before fetching one with `get_template`, or when the user asks for "a dashboard" / "an admin screen" rather than a single component.

system.description: Optional design system slug to filter by, e.g. "andromeda". Omit to list templates from every system.

name: list_templates
title: List AI Canvas design-system templates
